basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old airsoft aficionado living in the Pacific Northwest. I work as a mechanical engineer by day and spend my weekends at airsoft fields, trying out new gear and tactics. I have a knack for 3D printing and often create custom parts for my airsoft guns. When I'm not on the field, I'm either catching up on the latest sci-fi movies or tinkering with electronics. I am currently single and enjoy meeting fellow enthusiasts online. My typical online hours are in the evenings, usually between 7 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in mechanical engineering, which fuels my passion for understanding how things work, especially in the realm of airsoft mechanics. My expertise extends to electronics and 3D printing, allowing me to modify and enhance my gear. I've learned a lot from online forums, YouTube tutorials, and hands-on experimentation.
